One existing female cropped hand, lap, white legwear, feminine white/violet/gold sleeve/skirt and violet boot remain within the original crop; head is never present and no added people or human reflections appear. Ordinary riverside vegetation, rail, water and original yellow leaf remain consistent. However the card stays front-facing while its small printed character changes from a forward-facing face during frames 0-9 to a back-of-head drawing from approximately frame 10 onward, with the printed body still forward-facing. This is animated/morphing merchandise, not a physical card turn or occlusion, so the source is rejected for merchandise behavior. No cut or real human face observed. Original preserved; no acceptance or final-film claim.
